# Davide Bert — Senior software developer, Trento

> I learn how things work by building them.

## About

Davide Bert is a senior software developer in Trentino-Alto Adige, Italy. Since Oct 2025 at ewo (Cortaccia): product configurators in C#/.NET and React on MySQL, Kubernetes on GCP via Pulumi. 2020–2025 at Röchling Automotive (Laives): grew from specialist to Team Leader, Smart Factory Systems, on an IIoT platform across 22 plants and 400+ production lines. Started in 2017 as a junior .NET developer at Fercam.

## Flagship

- **MinerSentinel**: Self-hosted monitor for mixed home Bitcoin ASIC fleets (Bitaxe, Avalon, NMAxe, NerdNOS). One registry, canonical units, alerts, controls. Published on the Umbrel App Store. https://github.com/dcbert/miner-sentinel

## Also running

- **RaccBuddy**: Local AI companion with relationship memory. https://github.com/raccbuddy-labs/raccbuddy
- **Soryn**: TUI that shows what the GPU is waiting on. https://github.com/dcbert/soryn
- **HyprGrok**: Hyprland panel for Grok Build. https://github.com/dcbert/hyprgrok
- **NebulaProxy**: VPN-only dashboard for homelab apps. https://github.com/dcbert/NebulaProxy

## Side fun

- **Doge Astronaut**: Digital artwork delivered to the Moon. https://dogeonthemoon.com
- **Il Plebiscito della Mosca**: Fruit flies vote on Italian parliamentary motions. https://dcbert.github.io/plebiscito-della-mosca/
